result.summary: Found 1 major layout issue: a restaurant name is clipped by its card boundary in the horizontal carousel.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' row, the restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated by the card's right edge, so the full name is unreadable.
issues.suggestion: Allow the name to wrap to two lines, use a smaller type size, or give each card enough width so titles are not cut off.
